## [CN]来源与打分
## [EN]Source and score

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 用户提示词（原文）：「我已经更新了鸿蒙代码在模拟器上的截图 并更新了鸿蒙相关文档，请查看当前代码的运行截图，识别出截图中存在的问题 。给出issues猎鸟，每发现一个问题就新增一行，第二列写修复工作状态默认填TODO，给出打分机制，这个表格没有TODO 为满分，在没有模拟器的前提下修复issues，我会在你全部修复好后统一运行截图。每次修复一个issue就更新TODO为 TODO need 模拟器截图验证，更新所有TODO后视为满分。一直修复到满分为止。记录所有异常 不限于本仓库的异常，其他仓库的异常也一并列出。比如 tabbar 的badge为文字的时候，文字显示异常，NEW字样 无法一行显示，被换行了。疑似是badge大小未根据字体大小 字体做大小适配拉伸，怀疑是写死了badge的大小。需要根据label文字适配badge大小，参考android与I iOS端实现。 icon 与title y轴放点中心线未对齐。类似的issue也都要列出。」 | User prompt (translation): "I updated the emulator screenshots of the HarmonyOS code and the HarmonyOS documents. Look at the screenshots of the current code and find the problems in them. Give an issue list, one row per problem, with the fix status in the second column (TODO by default), and a scoring rule: the table is at full score when no TODO is left. Fix the issues without an emulator; I will take all screenshots once everything is fixed. Each time an issue is fixed, change its TODO to 'TODO need emulator screenshot check'; once every TODO is updated, the score is full. Keep fixing until the score is full. Record every anomaly, also those outside this repository. For example, when a tab bar badge is text, the text is shown wrong: 'NEW' does not fit on one line and wraps, probably because the badge size does not follow the font size and is hard-coded; the badge must fit its label, as on Android and iOS. The icon and the title are not aligned on the vertical center line. List every similar issue." |
| 截图：`origin/feat/harmonyos-component`（`81e3237`）的 `docs/assets/harmonyos-*.png`（Mate 70 Pro 模拟器，HarmonyOS 6.0.1，API 21）。 | Screenshots: `docs/assets/harmonyos-*.png` on `origin/feat/harmonyos-component` (`81e3237`) (Mate 70 Pro emulator, HarmonyOS 6.0.1, API 21). |
| 打分：每行 1 分。状态为 `TODO` 的行得 0 分；状态为 `TODO need 模拟器截图验证`（代码已修复，待截图确认）或 `DONE` 的行得 1 分。分数 = 得分行数 / 总行数 × 100。表中没有 `TODO` 时为满分。 | Score: one point per row. A row whose status is `TODO` scores 0; a row whose status is `TODO need 模拟器截图验证` (fixed in code, waiting for a screenshot) or `DONE` scores 1. Score = scoring rows / all rows × 100. Full score when no row is `TODO`. |

## [CN]问题
## [EN]Issues

| # | Status | Screenshot | Issue | Cause / fix |
|---:|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| 1 | TODO need 模拟器截图验证 | all four bar screenshots, tab "我的" | A text badge wraps: "NEW" is drawn on two lines ("NE" / "W"). | The badge size does not follow its text. |
| 2 | TODO need 模拟器截图验证 | styles-recheck col. 3, flatdesign-taps col. 3, ocean / space col. 3 | The number badge "8" on "同城" is a large circle that covers the icon in Liquid Glass, but small in the classic style: the badge size depends on the style instead of its text and font. | Not a size bug: the launch badge "8" plays `CYLBadgeAnimationType.Scale` (1.4 ↔ 0.6, repeating), as the Objective-C example (`MainTabBarController.m`); the screenshots caught it at different scales. The text size itself now follows the font (issue 1). |
| 3 | TODO need 模拟器截图验证 | tab-bar-svga-launch, styles screenshots | Icon and title of a tab are not on one vertical center line; the plus button's title "发布" sits lower than the other titles (launch: 2463 vs 2441 px). | Fixed: the plus button's aligned title and image use `cylTitleTop()`, the same line as the tab titles (centered icon + 3 vp + 13 vp title) instead of `tabBarHeight - 17`; titles get a fixed 13 vp height, `width('100%')` and centered text, the icon is centered in its frame (`alignContent(Alignment.Center)`), the column centers its children. |
| 4 | TODO need 模拟器截图验证 | every Home screenshot | Navigation bar: the "扁平样式 / 液态玻璃" buttons, the title "首页" and "换肤" are not on one center line ("换肤" higher, "首页" lower). | Fixed (demo `Index.ets`): the left buttons and "换肤" are 44 vp tall, positioned at `top: 0` and centered vertically, on the title's center line; before, positioned views without a height stuck to the top. |
| 5 | TODO need 模拟器截图验证 | every Home screenshot | The list has no bottom inset for the tab bar: the last row ("设置 CYLFlatDesignTabBarItem 背景色") is cut by the bar and the plus button and cannot be scrolled above it. | Fixed (demo): the demo list has `contentEndOffset(120)` (bar 49 + raised plus + gesture bar). |
| 6 | TODO need 模拟器截图验证 | styles-recheck col. 3, flatdesign-taps col. 3 | Liquid Glass: the selected item's highlight is a rectangle that sticks out of the left end of the capsule. | Fixed: in Liquid Glass a tab item's background has `borderRadius(tabBarHeight / 2)`, a capsule inside the capsule bar (the bar has `clip(false)` for the shadow, so children were not clipped). |
| 7 | TODO need 模拟器截图验证 | flatdesign-taps col. 2 | Liquid Glass while switching styles: the bar is drawn below the screen, over the gesture bar; titles are cut and the bar is narrower than the screen. | Fixed upstream before `81e3237` (b0dd6fd, "above the gesture bar, no side gap"); the later re-check screenshot (`styles-recheck-6befe36`, col. 3) shows the capsule in place. To confirm on a new screenshot. |
| 8 | TODO need 模拟器截图验证 | ocean col. 1 | Ocean skin, classic style: the bar is blue but the area under it (safe area) is white. | Fixed upstream in `47f8773` (#799): the classic container's color is `tabBarBackgroundColor`, which takes the skin's bar color (`this.theme.bar`), so bar and safe area match. The Ocean screenshot predates it. |
| 9 | TODO need 模拟器截图验证 | space col. 2, tint-fixed col. 1 | Space skin, FlatDesign: the bar is light grey (or dark) while the safe area under it has the other color: two tones. | Fixed upstream in `47f8773` (#799): a tinted FlatDesign bar draws the tint as is (no light blur) and the container uses the same tint. The Space screenshot predates it. |
| 10 | TODO need 模拟器截图验证 | ocean col. 2, space col. 2, tint-fixed col. 1 | A skin's plus button image is not scaled to the plus button: the wave / meteor image overflows above the bar over the list. | Fixed (demo): a skin's plus image is drawn at 40 vp (`CYL_SKIN_PLUS_IMAGE_SIZE`) instead of the 52 vp button size. |
| 11 | TODO | ocean col. 1, space col. 1 | The skin is applied to the tabs but not to the plus button in the classic style (beige "+" stays), while FlatDesign uses the skin's plus image. | Not found in code: `themeListener` sets the tabs and the plus button in the same call. Ocean col. 1 also shows "当前：默认" while the Ocean icons are on (issue 17): the screenshot looks like a state where the skin row and the plus button were not refreshed. Needs a reproduction on the emulator. |
| 12 | TODO need 模拟器截图验证 | ocean col. 1, tint-fixed col. 1, flatdesign-taps | The "NEW" badge is almost transparent on dark skins and in some states (faded red): the badge color takes the unselected / disabled alpha of the tab. | Not a color bug: the launch badge "NEW" plays `CYLBadgeAnimationType.Breathe` (opacity 0.1 ↔ 1), as the Objective-C example; the screenshots caught it faded. |
| 13 | TODO need 模拟器截图验证 | styles-recheck col. 3, space col. 3 | Liquid Glass: badges are placed inconsistently ("99+" covers the title "消息", "8" covers the icon, "NEW" is cut by the capsule edge). | Mostly the launch animations ("99+" bounces, "8" scales, "NEW" breathes); the badge center is the icon's top-right corner + 2 vp, as iOS. "NEW" now has its own width (issue 1) and the capsule items are rounded (issue 6). |
| 14 | TODO need 模拟器截图验证 | every Home screenshot | Localization: with Chinese UI, row subtitles stay in English ("tabBarHidden = false; hidden, it comes back after 2 s", "cyl_tabBarMinimizeBehavior = Never; tap to choose, then scroll this list"). | Fixed: 9 English subtitles of the demo go through `CYLLocalizedString` with format keys (`%@`), added to `scripts/harmonyos-l10n.json` (English, Simplified Chinese; other languages fall back to English) and generated with `scripts/harmonyos-l10n.py` (`--check` passes). |
| 15 | TODO need 模拟器截图验证 | every Home screenshot | The row "CYLFlatDesignTabBarItem 不居中显示（系统效果）" has no subtitle while the rows around it have one. | Fixed (demo): the row has the subtitle "cyl_itemEdgeInsets: zero, the tabs fill the bar" (localized). |
| 16 | TODO need 模拟器截图验证 | flatdesign-taps col. 1 | The selected tab's title changes to "刷新" with the same icon, but its highlight fills the whole tab cell as a square instead of the item shape. | Not a bug: the demo's item background row (`applyItemBackgrounds`, as "设置 CYLFlatDesignTabBarItem 背景色" in the Objective-C example) colors the whole item; the selected title "刷新" is the Objective-C example's too. In Liquid Glass it is now a capsule (issue 6). |
| 17 | TODO | ocean col. 1 | The skin row's subtitle says "当前：默认" (default) while the Ocean skin is shown on the bar. | Not found in code (the subtitle reads `this.theme`, set by the same listener as the icons); needs a reproduction on the emulator. |
